decided_by: the owner, amendment to directive 028, issued before any DEV metric was computed or inspected
clarification: Many unsure judgments were likely caused by the reviewer not understanding the language of the question or of the candidate evidence, especially non-English material. An unsure judgment is therefore not read as evidence ambiguity or as a retrieval failure. The reason for an individual unsure judgment is never inferred unless it was recorded.
unchanged: every frozen human judgment (gold_relevance_v1.jsonl, SHA-256 bda481d2...)
scoring semantics: an unsure item keeps its original rank and counts as neither relevant nor not relevant
the candidates, eligibility, primary metric, clear-winner test, practical-tie margins and subgroup safeguard

added_descriptive_reporting.per_candidate: Unsure@5 and Unsure@10 for every subgroup, as before

unsure_rate_of_gold_judgments.population: frozen gold judgments for DEV questions only; TEST questions' judgments are not summarized
unsure_rate_of_gold_judgments.definition: unsure judgments / all judgments in the cell

breakdowns.item_language: primary subtag of the item's stored feed language tag; 'unknown' when the item has no tag
breakdowns.item_english_vs_non_english: en, non-en, or unknown when the item has no tag
breakdowns.question_item_language_match: match when the question language equals the item language, mismatch when both are known and differ, unknown when the item has no tag

added_descriptive_reporting.status: descriptive only; never an input to retriever selection
